language.name: Ledger Dossier
language.rationale: Embodying stark investigative print discipline, this language strips away container panels entirely in favor of crisp editorial hierarchy, restrained monochrome tones, and a precise hairline underline that cuts cleanly over documentary footage.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (balanced density - 25/33px padding, 11px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule under the words, one clear space below them
surface: no surface - the words sit on the picture
motion: reveal at measured pace → preset line-reveal
over the picture: the heading (Ledger Dossier) reads 1.04:1 over a blown-out sky (floor 3) - this graphic depends on the shot being kind
over the picture: the supporting line (Ledger Dossier) reads 1.14:1 over a mid-tone shot (floor 3) - this graphic depends on the shot being kind
